A [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], '''''The Phantom Menace''''' featured various individuals<ref name="SWG" /> who were involved in the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The piece was painted in [[Color/Legends|red]] and earthy tones along with purple shadows.<ref name="SWG" />

The face of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] loomed in the background while twin yellow light sources were placed near the center of the piece, illuminating the scene. The portraits of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who donned her [[Throne Room Gown/Legends|throne room gown]], dominated the space above the [[Youngling/Legends|child]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], whose figure occupied the center of the painting's lower half. To the boy's right were [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], as well as a [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]] in flight. To Skywalker's left was [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], poised for [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]] with his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's first lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] ignited, as well as the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], who offered a smile.<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Phantom Menace'' was an obtainable painting in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. Players could acquire the painting with one "Buddy Token"&mdash;an in-game currency rewarded to those who invited new players to be ''Star Wars Galaxies'' subscribers&mdash;and use it in their house as decoration.<ref name="SWG" /> The in-game image is a cropped version of the theatrical poster for the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM" /> which was illustrated by [[Drew Struzan]] with acrylics and pencils.<ref name="Struzan">{{SWArchive|url=episode-i/release/promo/f20000310/index.html|text=The Making of the Poster}}</ref> The game later shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
